messages:
tara: Quick question for the onboarding shelf: instead of curated-only, what if first-run tries a lightweight auto-detect of 1-3 repos and falls back to curated samples if none found? keeps new users connected to their work but avoids big importer friction.

ev an: Nice hybrid. Are we planning to ask for repo access during signup? that could scare users.

tara: Ideally an inline connect button inside the checklist step`Connect repos (optional)` that triggers an OAuth popup. If they skip, show curated curated picks.

mikko: UX note: popup mid-setup is risky. put the connect button after "Try a sample project" CTA with a subtle link: "Use your code" so it's lower pressure.

abi: Research: users who are evaluating the product often don't have IAM rights to connect repos. For first-run we should assume many will skip. Good idea to still show their detected repo names if they connect later.

tara: Agreed. Implementation flow: 1) On first-run, call a harmless endpoint to check if code-host integration exists (no perms). 2) If integration exists, show a "Use your repos" preference (not automatic). 3) If user opts in, run a quick scan limited to repo names + language labels (no file read). Display up to 3 cards.

ev an: Sounds safer. detail: make clear microcopy: "We only read repo names and language labels, not file contents." Put that copy in the connect modal body and the hover tooltip.

mikko: Accessibility nits: modal must trap focus and return focus to the checklist toggle after close. Also the repo cards need proper aria-labels: e.g., `Repository: acme-search (JavaScript)` not just a bare link.

abi: Also color contrast for the language pill is low on the dark theme. small caps + 11px fails AA. let's bump to 13px semibold or increase background contrast.

tara: Good call. Also need alt text for screenshot previews: current placeholder is "screenshot.png" which is meaningless. Example alt: "Demo web UI showing results list and query box". We'll collect a set of descriptive alts per curated sample.

access-bot: security-check: oauth scope request must only include `repo:metadata` equivalent. No code read scopes.

mikko: Microcopy suggestion for the connect link: current 'Use your code' feels informal. alternatives: 'Show my projects', 'Connect repos (optional)', 'Use my repositories'. Which is clearest?

abi: Preference: 'Connect repos (optional)' because it communicates action and optionality. Add small help icon with tooltip explaining privacy.

tara: OK final decision: Hybrid default: curated samples shown by default. If the system detects a connected integration, surface a prominent, keyboard-focusable toggle at the top of the checklist step labeled `Connect repos (optional)` which opens the OAuth modal. If user opts in, replace curated cards with up to 3 detected repo cards (name + language pill + 1-line auto-generated blurb).

ev an: I'll scope backend: detect integration, fetch up to 3 repo names + language only, mark as cached for 24h. implement rate-limit.

mikko: I'll update comps: toggle first, modal copy, aria labels, focus flow, contrast tokens for pills, and sample alt text.

abi: I'll run 6 remote moderated sessions focusing on the connect flow language and update the onboarding copy doc with recommended tooltip wording.

tara: Action items: taracreate onboarding ticket + link comps, evanbackend detect + limit, mikkoupdate designs + a11y checks, abiuser tests and copy. Thanks all :rocket:
